gloss: to act violently; to rage; to run wild

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {暴|あば}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to act violently; to behave wildly
definitions.explanation: To behave in an uncontrolled, violent, or destructive manner.
When natural forces or animals become violent and uncontrollable.

notes:
{暴|あば}れる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). There is no direct transitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
{暴|あば}れている indicates an ongoing state of violent or wild behavior.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {暴|あば}れ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ - to run wild, to rampage
- {暴|あば}れ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ - to start acting violently
- ⟦{暴|あば}れん{坊|ぼう}→暴れん坊：noentry⟧ - a wild child, troublemaker

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧ - violence
- ⟦{乱暴|らんぼう}→乱暴：02482_ranbou⟧ - violent, rough (na-adjective)
- ⟦{荒|あ}れる→荒れる：04577_areru⟧ - to become rough/stormy (related but different nuance)
